# Reena Gupta · Candidate for Pleasanton City Council, District 3Here to Listen, Here to Serve
A strong economy and a vibrant community are not competing goals. One makes the other possible.
Most residents care deeply about Pleasanton but do not always have the time to follow City Hall or understand how local decisions affect them.
My mission is to increase civic engagement by bringing more voices to City Hall. Before earning the position, I want to start doing the job: summarizing City Council agendas, sharing short updates, collecting community voices, and reporting back what decisions mean for residents.
I am Reena Gupta, Pleasanton resident since 2011, mom of two PUSD graduates, entrepreneur, former Economic Vitality Commissioner, Leadership Pleasanton graduate, Pleasanton Connects Ambassador, PUSD Career Technical Education advisor and founder of the Mom Relaunch Foundation. I have spent decades investing in the people, businesses and future of this community.
So let me ask.
What is your vision for Pleasanton? What ideas do you have for our neighborhoods, downtown, businesses and future?
Tell me. I am listening.
Have more to share? See what the city is currently discussing and share your thoughts
Share Your Voice
Support Reena.$990$500$250$99$25Other
## What Matters to You Matters to Me
### Budget and Economic Vitality
New revenue. Transparent spending. Open for business.
### Historic Downtown
Vibrant. Multicultural. Alive for every generation.
### Water
Clean. Safe. Affordable. Always.
### Housing
Thoughtful housing. Right place. Right scale.
### Protecting What Families Count On
Safety. Parks. Roads. Libraries. Youth. Seniors.
### Workforce Readiness
Skilled residents. Strong economy. Future ready.
Learn More About My Priorities
## Civic Engagement
89%
of Pleasanton residents say the most trusted information comes from a friend or neighbor. Civic engagement starts when you know what is being discussed at your City Hall.
Stay informed. Share your voice. I will carry it there.
Summaries are AI-generated and reviewed by our team for accuracy. As with any AI-assisted content, mistakes are possible. Please let us know if you spot one.
